title: [DEPLOY-QUEUE][READY] CV exact-SHA transactional release
body:
## Queue contract

- **source_repository:** `rozkalnsandris/rozkalns-cv`
- **exact_git_sha_or_waiting_merge:** `d25730b20c41edff29a83927bff386751f053cd0`
- **source_pr_or_issue_if_applicable:** P5 inert audit fixture only
- **target_alias:** `rozkalns-cv-production`
- **execution_location_class:** `trusted-home-host`
- **repository_entrypoint:** `runner/release/rozkalns-cv-pull-deploy-main` fixed target helper selector
- **expected_baseline_when_observable:** resolve current production SHA through reviewed resolver immediately before mutation
- **read_only_preflight:** exact source SHA/current-main/CI plus helper identity and production baseline
- **verification_and_reconciliation:** summary final state and public contract must equal authorized source SHA
- **allowed_mutation_categories_and_limits:** one reviewed transactional CV release helper invocation
- **explicit_exclusions:** database migrations; shared ingress; control-plane; secrets/permissions
- **dependencies_if_any:** audited CV helper/library identities
- **deploy_class_and_extra_owner_gate_requirement:** `ORDINARY_LIVE_ALL_ELIGIBLE`; still requires separate LIVE-AUTH for deferred pull

## Evidence

P5 source-only fixture. It does not authorize or perform deployment.
